messages.quit.title: Quit Mebular?
messages.quit.hint: Esc or close the window to cancel
messages.quit.message.stopsDaemon: Quitting Mebular stops the local Mebular daemon (a temporary process started by this app). Permanent services and external daemons are not affected.
messages.quit.message.keepsDaemon: Quit the Mebular desktop shell. The local daemon is not managed by this app and keeps running.
messages.stop.message.stopsDaemon: Stop the local Mebular daemon (a temporary process started by this app)? The console will be unavailable; you can restart it from the tray.
messages.stop.message.external: The daemon is managed by a service or an external process, so this app cannot stop it. Use your system service manager instead.
messages.loading.notReady: Mebular is not ready: check the logs, or click Restart in the tray to retry.
messages.loading.portMismatch: Port {port} is used by another Mebular cloud. Stop it first.
messages.loading.instanceMissing: The daemon on port {port} has no instance identity, so this cloud cannot be confirmed.
messages.loading.conflict: The port is occupied by another Mebular cloud. Stop it first.
messages.loading.cloudSwitchFailed: Cloud switch failed; check the logs and try again.
messages.startup.error.title: Mebular failed to start
messages.update.title: Mebular Runtime update
messages.update.message: A new shared Runtime is available: {current} → {latest}. Nothing is installed until you confirm.
messages.update.message.service: The resident service is in use: the update briefly restarts the daemon (a few seconds); the console may be unavailable meanwhile.
messages.update.message.child: The update restarts the local daemon; running tasks may be interrupted.
messages.update.failed.title: Runtime update failed
messages.update.failed.message: Updating to {latest} failed ({reason}). {current} is still in use; the previous runtime, service and data were kept.
messages.update.reconnect.title: Runtime updated, reconnect failed
messages.update.reconnect.message: The shared Runtime was updated to {latest}, but this entry could not reconnect ({reason}). Restart the app or check the logs.
messages.update.busy.title: Runtime update in progress
messages.update.busy.message: Another entry is updating the shared Runtime; this entry will not install it again.
messages.tray.security.label: Security level: {level}
messages.wizard.step.start.title: ① Quick start
messages.wizard.step.assistants.title: ② Connect AI assistants
messages.wizard.tagline.idle: One click to connect this device
messages.wizard.logs.conclusion: The daemon is not running: click Start deployment to retry. If it keeps failing, check the logs below.
messages.wizard.complete.note.line1: To connect more assistants or invite other devices later, use the console:
messages.wizard.complete.note.line2: The ＋ Invite a device button in the top bar is always available.
messages.wizard.complete.restartNotice: Reminder: restart {apps} before mebular appears in its tool list.
messages.wizard.start.detail.doneRegistered: Daemon running (installed as a background service · launches at login).
messages.wizard.start.detail.doneManaged: Daemon running (app-managed): it stops when you quit the app. Keep Mebular resident to launch it at login.
messages.wizard.start.detail.doneUnknown: Daemon running. (Service state is still loading or unavailable.)
messages.wizard.start.detail.idle: One click starts Mebular and connects the AI assistants you already have. Data stays on this machine and is never sent to the cloud.
messages.wizard.start.doneLine.subManaged: This machine is running your Mebular
messages.wizard.assistants.detail.blocked: Finish step ① first: Mebular must be running before you can connect assistants.
messages.wizard.assistants.detail.empty: No installed AI assistants detected — install one and come back to click Quick start.
messages.wizard.assistants.detail.partial: Detected {installed} installed assistants ({connected} connected) — click Start deployment to connect them; failures are explained below.
messages.wizard.assistants.doneLine.sub: Restart the corresponding app to apply
messages.wizard.assistants.doneLine.noneSub: No AI assistants are installed on this machine
